dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible light-colored 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, jagged outer perimeters. A sharp pixel intensity transition is observed from the dark-grey base coat to the high-intensity off-white interior of the markings, characterized by non-linear, stippled borders.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity light-grey pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. These blobs are primarily concentrated in the interstitial spaces between larger annuli in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an elongated scalene triangle oriented diagonally across the midline. Secondary clusters of smaller high-intensity blobs are positioned in a linear arrangement parallel to the right lateral edge.
